mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Your Generac account requires a verification code. Enter the code sent to you via {method}.

error.auth: Invalid email or password. If you haven't reset your password since Generac's April 2026 security update, sign in at app.mobilelinkgen.com first to reset your password and accept any updated terms.
error.mfa_invalid: That code was incorrect or has expired. Enter the most recent code, or cancel and start over to get a new one.
error.mfa_unsupported: Your account uses a two-factor method this integration can't complete automatically (such as a push notification or security key). Approve the login in the MobileLink app, or switch your Generac/ecobee account to SMS, email, or authenticator-app codes, then try again.
error.auth0_unreachable: Could not reach auth.ecobee.com. Check the HA host's outbound network/DNS.
error.auth0_step_authorize: Auth0 /authorize step failed — the universal-login entry point did not accept our request. Check Settings → System → Logs for the 'Generac auth: step=authorize' line, then report at github.com/binarydev/ha-generac.
error.auth0_step_login_form: Auth0 login form (identifier or password) returned an unexpected response. The form fields or flow may have changed. Check the HA log for 'POST .../login/' lines.
error.auth0_step_resume: Auth0 /authorize/resume step failed — login appeared to succeed but the resume redirect was malformed. Check the HA log for 'Generac auth: step=resume' line.
error.auth0_redirect: Auth0 returned an unexpected redirect. Check the HA log for 'Generac auth:' lines and report at github.com/binarydev/ha-generac.
error.code_exchange: Auth0 accepted login but rejected the token exchange (DPoP/PKCE). Check the HA log and report at github.com/binarydev/ha-generac.
error.internal: Unexpected error. Check Settings → System → Logs for the full traceback and report at github.com/binarydev/ha-generac.

refresh_token_expiring.title: Generac sign-in for {username} expires soon
refresh_token_expiring.description:
Generac sessions expire 90 days after sign-in. The session for {username} expires around {expires}, after which your Generac devices will stop updating.

To renew it, go to Settings → Devices & services → Generac MobileLink, open the ⋮ menu, choose **Reconfigure** and sign in again. Tick **Remember password** to have the integration renew the session automatically from now on.

low_battery_voltage.title: Low battery voltage on {device_name}
low_battery_voltage.description: Generator {device_name} reported a battery voltage of {voltage} V, below the configured threshold of {threshold} V. Inspect the battery, charger, and terminals to ensure reliable starting during an outage.

missed_exercise.title: Generator {device_name} missed its scheduled exercise
missed_exercise.description: Generator {device_name} has not recorded a run or exercise cycle in {days_since} days (alert interval: {interval_days} days). Verify the generator is in Auto mode and inspect its exercise schedule and Mobile Link connection.

maintenance_due.title: Maintenance due for {device_name}
maintenance_due.description: Generator {device_name} requires scheduled maintenance ({reason}). After servicing the generator, press **Reset Maintenance Timer** on the device page to reset the countdown.

subscription_dunning.title: Mobile Link subscription billing issue for {device_name}
subscription_dunning.description: Generac Mobile Link reports a past-due or dunning subscription status for {device_name}. Update your payment method in the Mobile Link portal to avoid remote monitoring interruption.
